figurative_meaning_bn: অহংকার করা বা মাথা উঁচু করে গর্বিতভাবে চলা
figurative_meaning_en: To hold one's head high or to become arrogant
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার সাফল্যের পর মাথা তুলে হাঁটতে শুরু করল।
বিপদের মুখে সে মাথা তুলে লড়াই করল।
example_sentences_in_english: After his success, he started walking with his head held high.
In the face of danger, he raised his head and fought back.
note: This idiom often conveys a sense of emerging from humiliation or asserting oneself boldly in Bengali culture.
